acquisition.method: DuckDB httpfs read of the official object with a 1,000 row LIMIT, written back as ZSTD Parquet

measured_transfer.note: A row limit bounds the retained sample, not the network read. Measured on the yellow 2023-01 object with DuckDB HTTP logging enabled.
measured_transfer.conclusion: Reading any row of a single-row-group Parquet object transfers that whole row group.

acquisition.reason: M0 sampled 2024-01 and 2025-01 only. The two historical drift cases named by the M2 contract rules are not reproducible from those periods.

redistribution_policy: No TLC trip rows are committed; only derived metadata is published.

samples.derivative_note: Physical types match the upstream object recorded by M0 for this period.
samples.observed_drift: airport_fee is lower case here and Airport_fee from 2023-07 onward; passenger_count and RatecodeID are DOUBLE here and BIGINT later; VendorID and the location ids are 64-bit here and 32-bit later.

samples.derivative_note: Upstream declares airport_fee and wav_match_flag with the Parquet Null logical type. The DuckDB copy materialises both as INT32, so this derivative is not type-identical to the object M0 inspected.
samples.observed_drift: The location ids are 64-bit here and 32-bit from 2023-07 onward; cbd_congestion_fee does not exist yet; wav_match_flag is INT32 in this derivative where the contract requires a string.
